facts.content: Patient was stung by a wasp approximately 15 minutes ago while gardening.
facts.source_text: HPI: Stung by wasp ~15 min ago while gardening

facts.content: Patient has shallow breaths, chest tightness, lip tingling, and a blotchy rash without throat swelling.
facts.source_text: HPI: Stung by wasp ~15 min ago while gardening → shallow breaths, chest tightness, lip tingling (no throat swelling), blotchy rash

facts.content: This is the first episode of these symptoms.
Patient has a past medical history of eczema.
Patient has over-the-counter antihistamines available and uses them for aerosinusitis.

facts.content: Suspected anaphylactic reaction to wasp sting with respiratory symptoms and cutaneous signs.
